x: At STARTRADER, we combine trusted foundations with advanced technology to empower traders worldwide. As a global brand operating across 200+ regions and regulated by leading authorities, we provide secure access to 1,000+ CFDs through platforms such as MT4, MT5, STAR Copy, and the award-winning STARTRADER app.

Our international presence is strengthened through strategic collaborations, including our role as an Official Partner of the NBA, Official Partner of Porsche Carrera Cup Middle East, and Official Partner of the UAE National Cricket Team for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup.

Since our launch in 2019, our vision has been to make trading more accessible, trusted, and empowering - shaping both our products and our culture as we continue to grow by listening, evolving, and supporting our global community.

STARTRADER is the brand representing a network of regulated and licensed entities across various jurisdictions, each authorised to provide specific financial services in compliance with local regulations. STARTRADER Global Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis (Dubai-based entity) is licensed and regulated by the Capital Market Authority in the UAE to conduct promotion and client introduction activities only. All trading services are provided by STARTRADER entities regulated in other jurisdictions

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy for Startrader across brand, content, social media, email marketing, events and demand generation. The role builds Startrader's market presence among institutional clients and generates qualified pipeline for the sales team. Positioned within the Global Marketing team, the role works closely with group marketing functions to apply shared resources and brand standards, while aligning marketing priorities with Startrader's commercial objectives through a reporting line to the Head of Marketing.
